MERGE INTO BOK_SUBJECT_INTERNAL_RULE CII USING (
select #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BOOKSET_ID, #{subjectInternalCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE, #{genDetsubRule,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GEN_DETSUB_RULE, #{subjectLevel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AUTO_LEVEL, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.BOOKSET_ID = TEMP.BOOKSET_ID AND CII.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE = TEMP.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.GEN_DETSUB_RULE = TEMP.GEN_DETSUB_RULE, CII.AUTO_LEVEL = TEMP.AUTO_LEVEL, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BOOKSET_ID,SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE,GEN_DETSUB_RULE,AUTO_LEVEL,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.BOOKSET_ID,TEMP.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE,TEMP.GEN_DETSUB_RULE,TEMP.AUTO_LEVEL, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
